messages:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync — SI partner asked for a single signed artifact bundle containing: SOC2 summary (PDF), full pen-test report (redacted PII), questionnaire answers (CSV), and a short attestation from our security team. They want presigned links that expire after 7 days and a point-of-contact for each artifact. Listing go-live is targeted for next Wed, so we need final bundle by EOD Monday. Who owns what?

alan.security: I can own the attestation and SOC2 redaction notes. Need to confirm which fields to strip from the pen report — vendors often include creds/hostnames.

kevin.si: For the SI side: we need the raw findings export (not just the summary) so our integrators can validate fixes. We can accept redacted hostnames but need CVE IDs + proof-of-fix snippets. Is that doable?

sam.legal: NDA/consent note: before we hand raw exports to SI, we need an SI-specific DPA addendum signed or a scoped NDA waiver. Can we gate uploads until legal signs?

jade.ops: From an ops perspective I recommend 2 artifacts: a single tar.gz with all docs + a signed sha256sums.txt, and a presign manifest that lists URLs, expiry, and owners. I can run the presigns. Example commands:

jade.ops: ```bash
# package
tar -czf redwood-market-bundle.tar.gz SOC2-summary.pdf pen-report-redacted.pdf questionnaire.csv attestation.txt
sha256sum redwood-market-bundle.tar.gz > sha256sums.txt
# upload to S3 and presign
aws s3 cp redwood-market-bundle.tar.gz s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/4456789012/
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/4456789012/redwood-market-bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 604800  # 7 days in seconds
```

alan.security: That packaging flow works. For redaction rules: remove IPs, AWS account IDs, full hostnames, any user credentials, and redact stack traces that include tokens. Leave CVE IDs, test steps, and screenshots but blur screenshots where keys appear. I'll produce a redaction checklist by EOD Friday.

kevin.si: We can accept that. For proof-of-fix we can take a short code snippet or patched config diff + timestamped log showing the service restart. Prefer <100 lines.

maria.partnerships: Who will coordinate with the pen-test vendor (RedTeamLabs)? They ran the test and hold the raw report. We need them to produce a marked-up redacted version and an itemized findings CSV.

redteambot: @maria.partnerships RedTeamLabs upload completed: report id RT-99821 available for export. Raw report retained by vendor. Requesting export approval from vendor portal.

maria.partnerships: Thanks. @alan.security can you approve the export redaction scope with RT and confirm whether they can provide the itemized CSV? If RT needs a PII redaction template, use my earlier sample.

alan.security: On it — pinging RT now. Also looping @sam.legal for the SI DPA addendum.

sam.legal: Added a one-paragraph DPA addendum template to the shared drive (link pasted). If SI signs by Monday morning we can allow raw exports under the addendum terms. If not, we hold to redacted-only.

jade.ops: Small ops ask: presign expiry 7 days is fine, but for Marketplace ingestion we need a backup non-expiring storage pointer for auditors with restricted access (S3 lifecycle + bucket read ACL to compliance team). I can set that up with lifecycle + kms. Who will be the compliance viewer?

alan.security: Compliance viewer = "compliance-team@redwood.ai". I'll own request for KMS access policy.

kevin.si: Timeline check: we need itemized CSV + proof-of-fix snippets by Monday 12pm PT. Otherwise SI integration will stall and listing might slip.

maria.partnerships: Right — final owners: Alan = security redaction & attestation, Jade = packaging + presigns + backup bucket, Sam = legal sign-off, Kevin = SI acceptance criteria, Maria = overall coord and vendor comms. I'll create an owner spreadsheet and ping owners with tasks.

maria.partnerships: One last note — when we hand off the presign manifest, include the presigner's email and the bucket path so partners can verify authenticity. Use the filename pattern: marketplace-<partner>-<thread_ts>.tar.gz.

jade.ops: Acknowledged. I'll draft the packaging script and presign manifest template and drop to the shared folder by EOD Friday.

alan.security: I'll publish the redaction checklist + attestation template by Friday as well.

sam.legal: I'll review the DPA addendum and aim to get SI signature by Monday.

kevin.si: We'll queue the SI intake; I'll block Monday afternoon for validation. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:

maria.partnerships: Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the owner sheet and RT export approval.
